PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

  ?actor rdfs:label ?actorLabel .
  FILTER ( LANG( ?actorLabel ) = 'en' ) .
  FILTER ( CONTAINS( STR( ?actorLabel ) , 'Sigourney Weaver' ) )
}
